newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 15.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Editor of the Sunday Times newspaper, Sinha Ratnatunga, appeals a court decision to give him a suspended jail sentence for criminally defaming President Chandrika Kumaratunga.
Colombo businessman Harry Jayawardena to take over as chairman of national carrier Airlanka, sources said.
Government launches plan to boost local cement production to cut dependency on imports, says Industries Minister C.V. Gooneratne.

Main opposition United National Party lawmaker Gamini Athukorala says government should tell people that it is not capable of abolishing the executive presidency. The abolition of the executive presidency, which has been widely criticised for its sweeping powers, was one of the ruling People's Alliance coalition's election pledges.
